sources.title: FAA Japan Airlines Flight 1628 information releases
sources.scope: Locator verified through NARA finding aid; individual records not reviewed
sources.note: A civilian-aviation case queue with an official archival identifier. No radar-performance or origin conclusion is adopted from the collection title. Checked 2026-11-03: NARA's UAP bulk-download page (A035) lists this identifier, 733667, under the title "Roswell Report Source Files, 1987–1996" with a 2.91 GB ZIP, although this register identifies 733667 through NARA's finding aid as the JAL 1628 series. Identify the series by its identifier and catalog description, not that title, and list the ZIP's contents (zip-list) before relying on it. Lead, not verified: the same page lists FAA electronic records, 493468575, "Records from the Federal Aviation Administration Relating to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena"; check whether they include JAL 1628 material before citing them, and label anything found there NEW-1, NEW-2 and so on.

alternates.note: Catalog pages need JavaScript; the bulk download index (A035) and the optional Catalog API are the machine-readable routes.
